Music at the Farm

Find your rhythm. Build your confidence. Make music with us.

Private music lessons with Mark Wilson in Conway, Arkansas. Students of all ages are welcome, from toddlers to seniors—and beginners, too.

With over 11 years of teaching experience and a teaching license, Mark helps students explore the music they love.
